valor: Tamara, una inmigrante de mediana edad, trabaja limpiando el metro. Su rutina se intercala con recuerdos de una vida llena de baile. Un día rompe las normas sociales al bailar en un vagón, dejando atrás su invisibilidad y recuperando su identidad.

valor: Tamara, a middle-aged immigrant woman, works as a metro cleaner. Her daily routine is interspersed by memories of her past life filled with dancing. One day, she breaks social norms by dancing in a subway car, shedding her invisibility and reclaiming her identity.
